notes.title: A new Old School Musical DLC with mistermv is coming on June 25th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/d53aa7a5e09cf9d65449e99882e9452e01cacecb.jpg


After the DLC made in partnership with Toriena and the Switch and Mobile releases, Old School Musical is being expanded with one last DLC for the Chicken Republic Mode, with mistermv as the main musical featuring.

Coming on June 25th on Steam & Switch, this DLC is a partnership with Xavier “mistermv” Dang, a well known French streamer / youtuber. He’s also an amazing chiptune / electro musician who already composed video games soundtracks for various games, including Bokida & Crazy Frog Racer & released 10 EP albums.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/4e32163c2f16880cc728cbfba8c0c726591004c7.png


Like the Toriena DLC launched last November, this DLC will be completely free! If you’ve unlocked the Chicken Republic Mode, the new levels will be added at the end of the Chicken Republic levels.

This will also be the last DLC for Old School Musical (no more chickens after that), bringing  the number of tracks in the game to 60. We’re super proud of the final result, & we hope you’ll have as much fun playing it as we had making it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/82e7819015cd2f215720463f1f013757d08f6e1f.jpg


What's coming : 

- Discover 5 new tracks and challenges
- Stroll through MV Expo, the world's greatest chicken convention! MV Expo is your chance to dive into the loony universe of the eldest French streamer
- Brace yourself for the new challenges of Chicken Republic and its new diabolic modifiers
 
See you on June 25th, don’t forget to save the date & tell your friends.

You can follow Old School Musical on Twitter & Facebook & our publisher Dear Villagers on Twitter & Facebook not to miss news about Old School Musical.

You can also follow mistermv on his Twitter accounts mistermv (Streamer) / Xavier Dang (Composer) & Twitch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/24725ab32ce435641fdd8a7fb9551ba3128e2c07.png

We're more than happy to see that you are more & more playing OSM & we've started fixing issues you've told us on social media. But let's get to the point, here's the patchlog of what changes in this new version!

notes.title: Old School Musical is finally coming to PC & Nintendo Switch™ on September 13th!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/95938c52ea85e14571766bae0894ef0fc0e5d2b1.png

Stay in (chip)tune with the music in wacky rhythm game Old School Musical!

You thought you had seen everything in rhythm games? You are not ready for what’s coming! Discover our new teaser:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yvq0RvwpJ-w
Old School Musical is a retro rhythm game with a unique chiptune soundtrack that will send you back directly to the golden years of the 8-bit era. The main protagonists, Tib and Rob, have been trained to become video game heroes. One fateful day, their game gets corrupted by a bug invasion, thus pushing them to embark on an unlikely journey to find their missing mother and save our childhood games! Your skill, their success: miss notes and Tib and Rob's adventure will fall flat… Literally! 

Swing a crowbar, shoot with your spacecraft and defeat an evil chicken army to the beat of chiptune tracks from famous artists such as Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko and Le Plancton. Discover over 50 tracks, composed exclusively for the game! The OST will be available for purchase on Steam and other music platforms.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/ae9abddd471fe04507c669938a0046b9527e493a.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/5573067b5a667c9e5346fba362b8032638841cde.png

Old School Musical unique features include:

- Story Mode: Lead Tib and Rob in their crazy adventure filled with humor
- Arcade Mode: Reach the highest score and challenge your friends (if you have any)
- Challenge Mode: Play it hard with visual and audio penalties to unlock new music tracks
- 50+ chiptune tracks by the best of the chiptune scene: Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko, Le Plancton
- Travel through 20+ retro levels, inspired by our childhood games
- A multiplayer mode with up to 4 players
- Chickens

Old School Musical will be released on Nintendo Switch™ and PC on September 13 2018 for $12,99/12,99€.
You can now pre-order Old School Musical on the Nintendo Switch™ eShop or add it to your wishlist on Steam.

To stay up to date with the latest news and information regarding Old School Musical:
Please visit the official website
Like the official Facebook page
Follow the game on Twitter.
